assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$78,800 on May 4. Reaching $90,000 by Dec 31 requires +14.2% in ~8 months. BTC was up 17% in the past month already, and with 8 months of runway, a 14% rally to a level not far from prior cycle action is the base case. Historical 8-month rolling returns from this region tend to include such peaks frequently.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severe macro/regulatory shock could prevent any meaningful rally.
